original_text:
This is a total muddle. ARGUE is supposed to be done before VERIFY or INSTANTITE.  There's never been a case in which it was blocked on DOCUMENT, which is the last step.
>>> Nobody is working ARGUE. Its own work is finished and its finding recorded; it waits on DOCUMENT because one clause of its exit asks for the plain-language account DOCUMENT produces. "In progress" says someone is mid-task, which is a different thing and the wrong thing — it reads as a stall rather than a dependency.
quotes: Nobody is working ARGUE. Its own work is finished and its finding recorded; it waits on DOCUMENT because one clause of its exit asks for the plain-language account DOCUMENT produces. "In progress" says someone is mid-task, which is a different thing and the wrong thing — it reads as a stall rather than a dependency.
_note: An unmodified record except that absolute paths belonging to the machine that wrote it are replaced by <HOME>. A package carrying someone's home directory is a package nobody else can run, which is the defect this mission is about.
